WHO WE ARE.
WHAT WE DO.

The Great Pani Puri is a pani puri brand run from our Factory Machine Hub in Ratlam, Madhya Pradesh. We make ready-to-mix pani-puri masala in eight flavours, build the branded serving machine, and offer both machines and franchises to people who want to start their own counter.

🧂

We make the masala

Eight flavours of pani-puri masala, packed in 500 g pouches with the manufacturing date and best-before printed (8 months from manufacture).

⚙️

We build the machine

A stainless-steel and acrylic counter with flavour taps, LED lighting, storage and wheels, in full Great Pani Puri branding.

🤝

We grow with partners

Take the machine, or take a franchise and run the brand, the flavour menu and the look in your own city.

10 LITRES
IN 5 MINUTES.

Fast preparation means shorter set-up and less waiting before you serve. Each pack says: add 5 litres of cold water to the 500 g masala, so 10 litres uses two packs.

1Open your chosen flavour pack(s)
2Add cold water: 5 L per 500 g pack
3Mix well and let it blend
4About 5 minutes later, 10 L of pani is ready to serve

BENEFITS FOR
EVERYONE.

😋

For customers

Eight flavours, a crunchy shell and pani made fresh. Pick your favourite or try them all with the ₹99 unlimited plan. Jaljira and Hajma Hajam are traditional digestive-style flavours (a taste note, not a medical claim).

🧼

Clean and visible

The clear acrylic display and stainless-steel body let customers see everything, which builds trust at the counter.

⚡

10 litres of pani in about 5 minutes, and a movable counter on wheels, so set-up stays simple.

QUESTIONS


Do you sell machines and franchises?
Yes. You can buy a machine, take a franchise, or both. Send an enquiry for details.


What are the eight flavours?
Khatta Meetha, Chatpata Pudina, Khatta Tikha, Hing, Kaccha Aam, Lahsun, Jaljira and Hajma Hajam.


How is the pani prepared?
Each 500 g masala pack is mixed with 5 litres of cold water, as printed on the pack.


Where is the hub located?
9, Sagod Bibrod Main Road, Opp Van Vibhag, Ratlam, Madhya Pradesh 457001.
